shots.composition_notes: Single locked-off wide shot for the entire runtime, camera never cuts or moves. Two characters sit at opposite ends of a seesaw, facing each other in profile, positioned in the left and right thirds of the frame with the seesaw's fulcrum dead-center on the bottom third. Generous headroom above both heads; shallow depth of field renders the autumn park (trees, distant bench, path) as soft bokeh, isolating the two felt/wool-textured puppets against the background. Symmetrical two-shot with matching eyeline height keeps both characters equally weighted despite the woman being smaller/lower and the man's tall dark chair-back looming larger on the right, subtly overbalancing the frame toward him. Bottom-center caption strip (word-by-word subtitles) and top-right episode tag ('Episode 23') sit in the otherwise empty sky/ground margins without overlapping the characters.

framing_patterns_notes: The entire video is a single unbroken static wide shot with zero camera movement or cuts — all comedic and narrative beats are carried by dialogue, subtitle timing, and puppet performance rather than editing or reframing. The seesaw's fulcrum consistently anchors the geometric center of the frame, keeping the two-character composition symmetrical and stable throughout.
